prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair login and invitation fields in an iPhone family organizer. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS. Email keyboard autocorrects addresses, password is visible by default, placeholder is the only label and an invalid invitation deletes every entered value. Return key does nothing and no errors are associated with fields.

criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the text-fields guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.

criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task.
